document.title: Grandparents and childcare
document.question:
In many countries, grandparents now play a smaller role in bringing up their grandchildren than they did in the past.

Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
